name: TheClockworkBird
biography: TheClockworkBird With a background in anthropology and teaching, TheClockworkBird creates collaborative spaces where people of all skill levels and interests can engage with the puzzle. He has gained a multifaceted understanding of Cicada’s impact on the individual, and the impacts of collaborative puzzle solving on the growth of privacy awareness.
